_comment: Affiliate and referral links, kept out of the code so adding one is a data change. A program listed here is used ONLY for the outbound link; it never touches provider selection, which is automated on price alone. reader_benefit must be a real, verifiable offer, stated with its actual limits — it is shown to the reader as the reason the link is worth using.

programs.reader_benefit: $300 of credit for your first 30 days
programs.pays: $100 once the referred account is 30+ days old and has paid $100
programs.note: Chosen over the $10-per-signup code on expected value. The $10 code qualifies far more often — $10 of spend is one month on the boxes we recommend, against 5-10 months to reach $100 — but $100 at a lower qualification rate still beats $10 at a high one, and the $300 offer is a materially better reason for a reader to click. Revisit once there is real conversion data.

alternate.pays: $10 once the referred account is 30+ days old and has paid $10

programs.payout: PayPal, or Vultr account credit. Owner approved PayPal for automated income on 2026-09-04.

programs.pays: 10% of referred spend, monthly, for 12 months
programs.note: Publisher account approved on AWIN 2026-09-21; DigitalOcean must still approve us for their programme, which is what 'Pending Approval' on the merchant profile means. 'Link status: online' describes their programme being live on the network, not our membership of it. NOTE: digitalocean.com/affiliates still names CJ (Commission Junction) as the network — that page is out of date, the signup routes to AWIN. Recorded because the wrong network was previously stored here.
programs.blocked_by: DO_API_TOKEN. DigitalOcean is not in the provider catalogue, so no comparison recommends a DigitalOcean box and the tracking link would have nowhere to appear. The token must land before this programme can earn anything.

programs.note: Now the managed third option on 10 comparisons, so the traffic exists before the relationship does. Worth an email asking whether they run a referral scheme.
